item.title: Solved: How to Overcome Attempted Relative Import Issues in Python Packages
item.description:
Solved: How to Overcome Attempted Relative Import Issues in Python Packages

Navigating Python’s packaging system can be challenging, especially when dealing with relative imports. If you’ve encountered the error:

ValueError: Attempted relative import in non-package

You’re not alone! This common issue can arise due to various reasons related to how and where your module is being executed. Below, we’ll explore effective strategies to solve this issue, providing practical code examples that illuminate each approach.
